name: Feedback Training
columns: Customer that has no order history and no pantry list

rows.QUESTIONS:: For orders that has existing orders with same delivery date, should we add this to original order or we'll create a new one?
If there are products that can't be found in the Marketplace is it okay to use Miscellaneous?
rows.UK Feedback: No - Please inform team UK during training and then Adams team when you are live

rows.QUESTIONS:: When the customer only say the nmber of  qty, but didn't specify if box or Kg, what should we use?
rows.UK Feedback: Will have to enter best guess based off order history and inform adams team you are unsure what the QTY wanted was.

rows.QUESTIONS:: If there are emails or orders that are confusing can we directly ask the supplier?
There are inaudible voicemails, can we also ask/forward this to the supplier?
[SS] - Any stop credit rules or other business rules we need to know? Eg some orders should be placed in Southampton, right?
rows.Adams Feedback: Yes, may be some pre-payment rules that apply. Nicky will have a think about this. You may be given a list of customers that are on prepayment.

rows.QUESTIONS:: There are some product codes that's been hidden. Not sure what to do about this

rows.Customer that has no order history and n: The Galley at The New Port Arms

rows.QUESTIONS:: Feedback about the orders:

For The Crowborough Beacon Golf Club - he only says sprout is it brussel sprout or beans sprout and what should we use for pre peeled potatoes. It's a bit difficult for us since it doesn't have a pantry list.
rows.Adams Feedback: If they ask for Sprouts it will always be Brussel Sprouts. Pre-Peeled Potatoes = White ones are default 5kg bags

rows.QUESTIONS:: Orders in voicemails are too generic, are there default products that we can choose if they will only say (example) apple?
rows.UK Feedback: - This will have to depend on order history and then if you are still unsure create a note for the adams team that you wernt sure what apples they wanted.

rows.QUESTIONS:: For The Geese Brighton -- he wants cheddar cheese but it's too generic, it doesn't have a pantry list as well.

rows.QUESTIONS:: For tomato paste, can we use tomato puree?

Does new potato means Potatoes - Baby Mid? old potato is Potatoes - Washed White? and baking potato is Potatoes - Jacket?

There are 2 The Prince George Brighton , the Indigo Leisure and Veggie Dealer. If the caller will only say Prince George where should we place the order?
